summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (compiled-Bun header, hex-mangled identifiers, rotating string-array decoder, numeric dispatch table) that is not referenced by any of the package's advertised slate-react code path — it is reachable only via the preinstall dropper. Using an alternate JS runtime to execute an obfuscated payload at npm install time bypasses Node-based tooling and inspection. The package name is scoped as @ornikar/slate-react-fork but package.json declares the repository as git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git, an unrelated GitHub account, so the scoped name misrepresents the publisher of a slate-react fork.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
